{{Otheruses|Commander}}
{{Quote|The Empire wouldn't hit a ''Tagge'' family ship&hellip; one brother's an ''Imperial Fleet Commander!''|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 18">[[Star Wars (1977) 18|''Star Wars'' (1977) 18]]</ref>}}
Pivotal to any space campaign, '''Fleet Commanders''' were the battle coordinators for all space units under their command during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Culled from the best recruits in the galaxy, fleet commanders were trained at one of the Imperial military academies located throughout the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Or in the Rebellion's case, they were trained at one of the Imperial academies and later defected or came from elsewhere and were promoted.

They usually had their own [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], which was typically the most powerful warship in the fleets which they were part of. Fleet [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] were often targets of assassins and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired by the enemy.

In the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Assault on Kamino|assault]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], [[Touler]] served as the Imperial fleet commander. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Gherant/Legends|Gherant]] served aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] as the Fleet Commander of the massive [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] armada assigned to protect the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="ROTJ junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the game ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', Fleet Commanders increase the health and sight range of all nearby friendly ships and were also capable of detecting stealth units. This could be explained as the presence of the commander increasing morale.
